COURSE OUTLINE
COMP9991 - Foundations of Data Structures
Overview: Students study linked lists, stacks, queues and binary search trees.
Topics: Week 1 linked lists. Week 2 stacks and queues. Week 3 binary search trees.
Assessments: Quiz 1 worth 10%, due 20 March 2027. Assignment 1 worth 30%, due 10 April 2027.
Learning outcomes: implement linked lists and explain tree traversal. This course is synthetic for evaluation.

input.context: A stack is a last-in-first-out data structure. Push adds to top; pop removes from top.
